An addendum dated 2026-09-01 in the sibling arc B1186 (this fresh-physics-seat campaign) shows the 'mirror-isometry method' this arc explicitly chose to avoid a known vacuity trap (isometry_signature) is itself vacuous in SnapPy: reverse_orientation()+is_isometric_to() is orientation-blind and returns True on every input. The chain of claims '14/14→83/83→111/111→112/112 amphichiral' across B1180/B1181/B1186 is therefore not a real result; recomputed with symmetry_group().is_amphicheiral() the true count on the 112-member family is 38/112.
